text_simplified: An active child needs to engage in physical activity such as walking or climbing stairs for 30 minutes daily. Parents should encourage the child to drink water instead of sugary or carbonated drinks. Avoid adding excess sugar and salt to food to prevent obesity and heart disease. Choose natural foods and fruits over processed sweets.

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses 'and' (الواو) to list two categories of drinks, while the English uses 'or', which changes the meaning to imply either one rather than both.
